project.name: keel
project.description: House standard operating procedure for AI-assisted delivery

verify.lint: shellcheck -x bin/keel lib/*.sh tests/*.sh tests/evals/run.sh tests/evals/stage.sh hooks/session-start hooks/context-watch hooks/sensitive-guard hooks/done-guard

deploy.note: Distribution is `/plugin marketplace add gbi-solutions-ltd/keel`. No server.

artifacts._note: Set any of these to a path when the artifact already exists elsewhere. Skills read the mapped path instead of the default under docs_root, so a repo with its own naming convention is not duplicated.

_note: keel dogfoods itself. Written by hand until `keel init` exists (plan task 1.6).

verify_notes.test: Plain bash. No test framework, by design: the CLI has no runtime dependency and neither do its tests.
verify_notes.lint: shellcheck at default severity, so info and style findings fail too. CI runs this exact string. Running a narrower severity locally is how the pipeline went red on 52 findings that had never been seen on a laptop.
verify_notes.build: None. Skills are markdown and the CLI is bash, so there is nothing to compile.
